title: Selling Plans — Performance Level Discount and Surcharge Terms by Plan
content:
The final value fees of every **Selling Plans** tier respond to the seller's Seller Performance Standing level on the order date. The terms below are the same on all six plans: the Individual Seller Plan and the Starter, Basic, Premium, Anchor and Enterprise Store.

| Term | Figure on every Selling Plans tier |
|---|---|
| Top-rated final value fee discount rate | 10% of the variable final value fee |
| Performance levels that earn the discount | Top Rated Level; Preferred Partner Level |
| Maximum handling time for the discount | 1 business day between the order date and the shipped date |
| Fee components the discount reduces | The variable final value fee only |
| Below-standard surcharge rate | 6% of the fee basis, billed as an additional final value fee |
| Performance levels that pay the surcharge | Below Standard Level |

## Points of judgement

1. **Which component does the discount touch?** Only the variable final value fee. The per-order fee and the below-standard surcharge are never reduced by it.
2. **Which levels sit outside both lists?** Developing Seller Level, Standard Level and Above Standard Level appear in neither list: they earn no discount under this term and pay no surcharge.
3. **Handling time, both sides (hypothetical orders).** An order shipped 1 business day after its order date is within the 1-business-day maximum; an order shipped 2 business days after it is not.
4. **Surcharge on a hypothetical order.** For a seller at Below Standard Level on the order date, an order with a fee basis of USD 200.00 carries a surcharge of 6% of USD 200.00, which is USD 12.00.
